senses.gloss:
चट् चट् (a dialectical form of चर्त्. vb. चृत्), i. 1, Par.
 1. † To rain.
 2. To cover.
 3. To separate, Pañc. 121, 1.
 --i. 10 (rather Causal), चाटय,
 1. To separate.
 2. † To kill.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To disappear, Bhāg. P. 5, 9, 18.
 --Caus. To drive out, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 28.

चटक चटक, m. A sparrow, Pañc. 80, 5. f. का, A hen-sparrow, Pañc. 80, 10.
 --Comp.
चटचटाऽ चटचटा-, (an imitative sound), Clashing, MBh. 1, 7110; roaring, 3, 10980.
चटचटाय चटचटाय (a denomin. derived from the preceding by य), Ātm. To crackle, Suśr. 2, 245, 20.

चटुल चटुल, adj.
 1. Unsteady, Ragh. 9, 58.
 2. Inconstant, Amar. 71.
 3. Beautiful, Gīt. 10, 9.
चाट चाट, m. A rogue, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 907.
चाटु चाटु, m. and n. Pleasing, flattering discourse, Ṛt. 6, 14.
चाटुकार चाटु-कार, m. A flatterer, Rājat. 5, 351.
